records.note: The count is the Ministry of Panchayati Raj's state/UT-wise total Gram Panchayats and equivalents for GPDP plan year 2025-26, as reported from e-GramSwaraj on 29 January 2026. GPDP uploaded is a separate progress count, not the number of all functioning local bodies. Counts are retained as published; a missing region from the annexure is not inferred to have zero.
records.panchayatStatisticsSourceTitle: Ministry of Panchayati Raj — eGramSwaraj status of GPDP/BPDP/DPDP uploads, Plan Year 2025–26 (report generated 13 July 2026)
records.panchayatStatisticsNote: Official state/UT-wise eGramSwaraj table. District Panchayat and Block Panchayat counts are official equivalents; Block Panchayat equivalents are mapped to the existing Intermediate Panchayats display field. These are not development-block counts. Zero is retained only where the Ministry table explicitly reports zero. GPDP/BPDP/DPDP uploaded counts are progress figures and not counts of local bodies.
